data.narrative:
Sygaldry Technologies is a Series A AI & Software company that has raised $139M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 private and 1 public comparable (Palantir), representing the frontier AI sector at similar or adjacent stages. Key private peers include Reflection AI ($25.0B), Together AI ($8.3B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $139M total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $278M. Peer-median analysis across the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $7.0B, with a range spanning $3.2B (Black Forest Labs) to $25.0B (Reflection AI). The peer-median approach reflects the wide dispersion in frontier AI valuations at this stage.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $236M (low) to $8.0B (high), with a median of $3.6B. The stage-progression method yields the low bound; the peer-median anchors the median and high bound. Key uncertainties include product maturity and differentiation relative to the peer set, which exhibit substantial valuation variance. The wide spread between methods reflects fundamental uncertainty in pricing early-stage AI companies absent revenue or near-term profitability markers.
